journey.name: Edit: Curves look, light and dark
journey.action: On Home, scroll until the shortcut row shows, tap "Edit", then tap a photo in "Edit: choose a photo".
journey.check: The graph is wide (clearly wider than tall), with only a frame and three vertical lines: no diagonal guide, no horizontal lines.
Above it four entries read RGB, R, G, B, each with a colour dot; RGB's dot shows three colours; RGB is chosen.
The RGB line is the normal text colour and easy to see against the graph's background.
A trash icon and a Reset icon sit in a column right of the graph, trash above Reset, both fully on screen; nothing in the sheet is cut off.
journey.action: Tap on the line about 40% of the way across.
journey.verify: A third point appears on the line and is drawn differently from the end points (hollow, with a thicker ring of the line's colour); the trash icon becomes enabled.
The line and points turn red, nothing is selected, and the trash and Reset icons are disabled.
journey.action: Leave Edit (Back, Discard), open Settings, Theme mode, Dark; go Home and repeat every step above.
journey.verify: In dark the same arrangement holds: wide graph, four entries with dots, light line for RGB and a light red line for R, the selected point stands out, both icons beside the graph; nothing cut off, nothing hard to see.
journey.action: Discard the edit and set Theme mode back to System default.
